description:
What's New in v1.0.4 🚀

Upgraded UI Framework: Migrated the application interface to PyQt6 for a smoother, modern, and highly responsive user experience.

Optimized Performance & App Size: Streamlined internal dependencies and applied advanced compression to deliver a significantly smaller installer size.

Automated FFmpeg Integration: Seamlessly downloads and configures FFmpeg during installation for hassle-free media processing.

Stability & Bug Fixes: Fixed system tray behavior and resolved module dependency issues for rock-solid background performance.
